title: Unsuspicious Block
description: This mod adds allows players to inspect the hidden loot inside Suspicious Blocks without using a brush.
body:
**Unsuspicious Block** used to be a lightweight mod that lets you quickly reveal the loot hidden inside suspicious blocks without long brushing sessions, while recording every excavation in the **Archaeology Journal**. Starting with v1.2.0, this mod added more content. **Please see the changelog for more details**.

---
## Features

### Archaeology Journal

The **Archaeology Journal** is the core feature of this mod. It automatically records all of your archaeology discoveries. Since v1.2.0, it's no longer limited to archaeology; loot chests and fishing can also be tracked. Simply add the loot table you want to log to the config.

#### Recipe
|![recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5281a56e040524b1f8316dbcdadc54bcf238476b.png)|
|:----:|
|Archaeology Journal recipe|

#### Interface Preview

The Archaeology Journal automatically scans all archaeology loot tables in the game, displays them by structure name, and is also compatible with loot tables added by other mods.

|![intro](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f60fcd49929ea50d1135e75c555c4e504403ccc.png)|![journal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cf7be8c7b463e5905c7ea0e2c3d55461ce8553a0.png)|
|:-----:|:------:|
|Loot table catalog|Item details page|

#### Unlock Status

Each time you brush out a new item, the Archaeology Journal automatically unlocks the corresponding entry and records it.

When no entries have been unlocked yet, the interface looks like this:

|![unlock1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2342f9c4cd036d68b9320dbb1ee4435b4235aeca.png)|![unlock2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fbf93281469a876bcdf7ede8dc2c94b68b072839.png)|
|:-----:|:-----:|
|No loot tables unlocked|No items unlocked|

### Suspicious Reader

The **Suspicious Reader** reveals the hidden loot inside any suspicious block with a right-click.

|![jade](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/905a378a9b3874a6ecbc888ad2396596c5d5af30.png)|
|:---:|
|Jade integration preview|

- Right-click to immediately reveal the contained item
- Automatically sync the result to the Archaeology Journal
- Compatible with all block entities derived from `BrushableBlockEntity`, including suspicious blocks added by other mods
- When used with Jade, the scanned item information can be shown directly in the HUD

> Note: In survival mode, displaying full block details in Jade requires setting `builtinCamouflage` to `false` in `<version_file>/config/jade.json` (default is `true`).
